statements.t: “All four of our product candidates are on track to deliver important clinical milestones in 2027, including the initiation of our Phase 3 trial for ribupatide oral and the data readout from the ribupatide injection high-dose Phase 2b trial.

With the ribupatide franchise’s category-leading potential at the core of a diversified portfolio, and a balance sheet that supports multiple value-creating inflection points into mid-2028, I am proud of our team and energized by what we aim to deliver for people living with obesity."
